# Suryavamshi Solar Projects LLP

> Rooftop solar installer based in Cherthala, Kerala, India. Designs and installs on-grid and hybrid solar systems for homes, and handles the KSEB feasibility check, net-metering application and the PM Surya Ghar subsidy claim (up to ₹78,000) for customers. Serves Cherthala, Alappuzha, Kochi (Ernakulam) and Kottayam.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9061626868
- Email: suryavamshisolarprojects@gmail.com
- Address: Door No. 414, Chithira, Muttathiparamb P.O, Cherthala, Kerala 688527
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM
- Free site assessment: https://suryavamshi.com/contact.html
- Warranty (from our sample 3 kW proposal): 25-year panel performance warranty (at least 90% output at 10 years and 80% at 25 years), 5-year system warranty from commissioning with free inspection visits during the warranty, inverter warranty from the maker (typically 5 to 10 years)
- Roof space: about 100 sq ft of shade-free roof per kW, so about 300 sq ft for a 3 kW system

## Tools
- [Solar calculator](https://suryavamshi.com/calculator.html): sizes a system from a monthly KSEB bill or units

- [5 kW solar system for Kerala homes](https://suryavamshi.com/5kw-solar-system-kerala.html): typical estimate ₹2.8 to ₹3.1 lakh before subsidy
- [8 kW three-phase solar system](https://suryavamshi.com/8kw-solar-system-kerala.html): 13 Vikram TOPCon panels, Solinteg inverter, ₹4,00,000
